grammar.label: be used to and get used to
grammar.meaning: being accustomed to something, and becoming accustomed

explanation.en: 'Used to do' is a past habit. 'Be used to doing' means it is now normal for you. 'Get used to doing' is the process of becoming accustomed.
explanation.uz: 'used to do' — o'tmishdagi odat. 'be used to doing' — endi siz uchun odatiy. 'get used to doing' — odatlanish jarayoni.

grammar.positive_example: I am used to working late, but I am still getting used to the commute.
grammar.negative_example: I am used to work late.

l1_notes.uz: 'to' bu yerda predlog, shuning uchun keyin -ing keladi, asosiy fe'l emas.

grammar.label: past ability and achievement — could, was able to, managed to
grammar.form: could / was able to / managed to
grammar.meaning: general past ability against one successful occasion

explanation.en: 'Could' describes general ability. For one occasion where you succeeded, use 'was able to' or 'managed to': 'I could swim, and I managed to reach the boat.'
explanation.uz: 'could' — umumiy qobiliyat. Bir martalik muvaffaqiyat uchun 'was able to' yoki 'managed to': 'I could swim, and I managed to reach the boat.'

grammar.positive_example: The traffic was terrible, but we managed to arrive on time.
grammar.negative_example: The traffic was terrible, but we could arrive on time.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham '-a oldim' bilan beriladi; farq faqat ingliz tilida.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Fine. I am still getting used to the noise.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: It took me a year to get used to the traffic here.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: You are used to it now?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I am. I am used to leaving an hour early.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: The bus was full this morning, but I managed to get on.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I could never do that when I arrived.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: The first week I was not able to buy bread. I did not know the word.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And now you argue with the seller.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: I do. Last week I managed to get the price down twice.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then there is hope for me.
